source.provenance: gk-015-r04/higgsfield-evidence.json (Creator-requested GPT Image 2 extraction of the selected reference; reference-derived POC imagery, not a product photograph)

method: On-device Apple Vision VNGenerateForegroundInstanceMaskRequest (macOS 27.2). The soft subject mask became the alpha channel of the ORIGINAL pixels; then a lossless crop to the subject bounds + 24px. No generation, retouching, recolouring or paid image service.
notes: One foreground instance (cake, flowers and stand). Enclosed gaps are transparent, including the pocket cleaned in step 2. Limitations: soft edges retain the original backdrop grey (a halo on dark colours only; not visible on Satin, Porcelain or Brushed); the leaf edge bordering the cleaned pocket keeps its feathered grey. A thin natural contact shadow under the base was kept by the mask; the page adds a soft CSS ground shadow. PNG is 875 KB (lossless, straight alpha); production should use an optimised derivative.
